<!-- Read CONTRIBUTING.md before submitting. Report vulnerabilities privately to
huynhderic@gmail.com instead of opening a public pull request. -->

## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and how this change affects users. Include a small
before/after example when useful.

## Related work

Link relevant issues or roadmap items. Use "Fixes #..." only for an issue this
pull request fully resolves.

## Validation

List the exact commands you ran and their outcomes. Identify checks you could
not run and why. For a behavior fix, describe the regression test. For a
documentation-only change, describe the link and instruction checks.

Attach relevant report artifacts or measurements for coverage or performance
claims, including their environment and revision.

## Compatibility and limitations

Describe any API, wire, storage, authority, dependency, or platform effects, plus
remaining limitations. Write "None" if there are no such changes.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and the code of conduct.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and regression coverage reflect the change, or I
      explained why they are not needed.
- [ ] The description states what was checked and what remains unverified.
- [ ] Vendored changes preserve licenses and update provenance where applicable.
- [ ] The patch contains no live secrets or unintended generated artifacts.
